name: traveller_camp
description: The Traveler's Camp (legend/traveller_camp), the Wanderer's Tipi, rebuilt from scratch for ROADMAP 49 (tools/blueprints/briefs/traveller_camp.md, REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Build output goes to build/rebuild/traveller_camp/out; until the critic says SHIP, 'build' writes a candidate (frames.py adds the map's frame, the one entity).

scripts.build: node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir ../../../../build/rebuild/traveller_camp/out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py traveller_camp legend/traveller_camp --candidate --nbt ../../../../build/rebuild/traveller_camp/out/traveller-camp.nbt && python3 frames.py ../../../../build/rebuild/traveller_camp/legend/traveller_camp.nbt
